outcome.technical: drive-phase.py: with executor.writerModel (passed as given; the runner refuses an alias) and executor.writerBudgetUsd set, the executor dispatch becomes step dispatch-writer: audit-lookup.py brief --role writer writes the plain prompt, the line reads `dispatch run-agent-session.py --role writer --task <id> --model <id> prompt=<path>`, the signal basis names `run-agent-session.py --role writer model=<id>`, and --explain prints the whole command as a `run:` line (signal_of gained `runs`; wave_said carries them). The command passes --record <stateDir>/sessions/drive/<task>.<start>.<round>.json; note_sessions (top of advance) reads each record once and writes `audit-task.py note` with the session id and total_cost_usd from the session's own result (or, for a run with no result, the runner's words and no cost). A red task gate goes through gate_red_decision: with a recorded session and fewer than MAX_RESUME_ROUNDS (2) resumes spent it asks gate-red-writer (resume|retry|rerun|block, rule recommends resume and says no attempt is spent), storing the gate's failing lines; --answer resume writes them as a prompt file and prints step resume-writer with --resume <session>, no start_task, so no attempt. After the second resume a still-red gate writes one note naming each resumed run's stream and cost, then asks the plain gate-red (retry|rerun|block), whose retry starts a fresh session.
